rationale: META sits mid-range (648) between support 626 and resistance 690, right at VWAP with a bearish 4h divergence but flat 15m/30m/5m momentum and micro volume (many bars <3 units). Wait for a support break to trigger a short, or a 656 reclaim to negate the bear case.
